stories.title: Meta 的 Muse Charm 或定价 300 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
stories.summary: The Information 报道，Meta 计划把这款带屏幕、可与 Muse AI agent 对话的小设备定价 300 美元；扎克伯格今年早些时候已展示该产品，并称公司预计会按期出货。
stories.analysis: 300 美元把 AI 可穿戴压到“配件”价位，Meta 是在用硬件抢 agent 的随身入口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm

stories.title: Google 首页上线可折叠 AI 聊天侧边栏
stories.sourceTitle: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
stories.summary: Google 产品副总裁 Robby Stein 在 X 上演示，首页新增可折叠侧边栏，用户能查看并继续自己的 AI 对话。
stories.analysis: 把 AI 对话直接放到全球流量最大的首页，是一次防守型的搜索入口改造。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google is updating its homepage to include AI searches. In a post on X, Google's vice president of product, Robby Stein, shows how you can now open a collapsible sidebar to view and continue your AI chats. Based on the GIF shared by Stein, it looks like you ca

stories.title: Apple 招工程师自研 AI agent，可浏览网页、跨应用操作、写代码
stories.sourceTitle: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
stories.summary: 据 Bloomberg 发现的招聘信息，Apple 正招募工程师开发能浏览网页、跨应用工作、编写代码并调用服务的 AI agent。
stories.analysis: Apple 在补 agent 能力的短板，但招聘信息距真正落地仍有距离。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which says Apple is looking for an engi

stories.title: NVIDIA 财报后股价跌至约 150 美元，较此前跌近 40%
stories.sourceTitle: A brief history of Nvidia’s recent stock fluctuations
stories.summary: 临时 CEO Colette Kress 在第三季度财报电话会结束时称“我们撑得住”，但到周四股价已徘徊在 150 美元/股左右，较此前下跌近 40%。
stories.analysis: 一周内近四成的跌幅说明市场对 AI 算力需求的预期已从狂热转向审视。
stories.sourceExcerpt: "We've got this," Colette Kress, interim CEO of Nvidia, said Tuesday night as she closed out the embattled chip company's third quarter earnings call. By Thursday, the company's stock price was hovering at around $150 per share, a nearly 40 percent drop from i

stories.title: Apple 或在开发可操控 Mac 的自有 AI agent
stories.sourceTitle: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
stories.summary: 报道称这家 iPhone 厂商正在构建 agent，对手包括 Meta Muse、Instinct、Claude 和 OpenAI Dots。
stories.analysis: 与招聘线索互相印证，Apple 的 agent 路线瞄准的是桌面系统级控制。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.

stories.title: Anthropic 七位创始人在破纪录 IPO 中合计套现近 20 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
stories.summary: 按上调后的 83 美元/股发行价计算，七位创始人各套现 2.8 亿美元，公司募资近 1050 亿美元。
stories.analysis: 创始人上市即大规模变现能兑现激励，但也会放大外界对团队长期承诺的审视。
stories.sourceExcerpt: At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion.

stories.title: Anthropic 登陆纳斯达克，开盘 111.50 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street
stories.summary: Anthropic 以代码 ANT 在纳斯达克开始交易，开盘价 111.50 美元，高于 83 美元发行价，对应公司估值约 1.5 万亿美元。
stories.analysis: 首个前沿实验室的公开市场表现，将成为后续 AI 公司上市的定价锚。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic has officially gone public. It began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT" at $111.50 per share, up from its initial $83 per share price that put company's value at around $1.5 trillion. The listing comes nearly a month after Anthropic

stories.title: Meta 未否认 Muse Charm 定价 300 美元的报道
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s new Muse Charm device may cost $300
stories.summary: 面对 The Information 的报道，Meta 没有否认，只表示这款即将推出的 AI 可穿戴设备“很快会有更多分享”。
stories.analysis: 不否认基本等于默认定价，剩下的悬念只是发布时间和实际体验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta hasn't denied the reporting from The Information, saying only that it will "have more to share soon" about its upcoming AI wearable.

stories.title: 航空订票、银行、生产力平台接连故障，安全专家称并非巧合
stories.sourceTitle: These tech outages are giving Y2K, AI agent style
stories.summary: 报道指出，近期航空公司订票系统、银行平台和生产力平台的故障可能不是巧合，网络安全专家认为背后有更深层的原因。
stories.analysis: 自动化 agent 一旦出错，故障会以跨系统连锁的方式暴露，而不只是单点宕机。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Are the recent outages in the airline booking systems, banking platforms, and productivity platforms really a coincidence? There's actually likely something deeper going on, cybersecurity experts say.

stories.title: macOS 版 Gemini 获得 computer use 能力
stories.sourceTitle: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
stories.summary: Google 称 Gemini macOS 应用现在能跨本地文件、桌面应用和网页完成多步骤任务，可用于加速工作流、整理文件等场景。
stories.analysis: 把 agent 直接装进 macOS，Google 是在浏览器之外抢桌面入口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google's Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you "get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web," the company says. Google suggests the feature might be useful for things like speeding up workflows, fil

stories.title: 黄仁勋因婚外情辞去 NVIDIA 职务，事件时间线被梳理
stories.sourceTitle: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
stories.summary: TechCrunch 按时间顺序还原黄仁勋辞职经过，并指出在中美竞逐最先进 AI 基础设施之际，此事可能带来国家安全层面的影响。
stories.analysis: 创始人突然离场叠加中美算力竞争，NVIDIA 的治理与政策风险同时被放大。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Canva 允许用户关闭生成式 AI 功能
stories.sourceTitle: Canva adds an AI ‘off’ button
stories.summary: Canva 现在可以停用 Magic Expand 等 AI 工具，也能关闭用其模型生成图片的功能。
stories.analysis: 给用户一个 AI 开关，正在成为设计类工具在合规与信任上的标准配置。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Canva will now allow you to turn off its generative AI features. With this change, you can disable the graphic design platform's array of AI tools, such as its AI photo-extending Magic Expand feature, as well as turn off the ability to generate images with its

stories.title: Gemini API 上线 Tool Retrieval，让 agent 按需调用数百个工具
stories.sourceTitle: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
stories.summary: 该功能以预览形式提供，Google 称可让 agent 接入数百个工具，同时消耗更少的 token。
stories.analysis: 工具数量上去后，用检索替代全量塞进上下文，是 agent 规模化的必经工程。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Give your agents access to hundreds of tools while using fewer tokens with Tool Retrieval, now in preview in the Gemini API.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO 或为慈善带来 1560 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic’s IPO could deliver $156B to charity
stories.summary: 按 95 美元股价计算，Anthropic 的 Public Benefit Foundation、员工捐赠和公司配捐合计约 1560 亿美元。
stories.analysis: 把公益结构绑定 IPO 收益，是 Anthropic 维持“好人”叙事的关键制度设计。
stories.sourceExcerpt: At a stock price of $95, the frontier lab's Public Benefit Foundation, its employee donations, and the company's match tot up to $156 billion.

stories.title: Walter Isaacson 与 Google 对谈 AI 时代的好奇心与创造力
stories.sourceTitle: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
stories.summary: Isaacson 在 Google 的节目中讨论历史上的创新者如何启发 AI 时代的创造力与人类判断力。
stories.analysis: 内容偏品牌叙事，真正信号是 Google 想把“人类判断”留在自家 AI 产品的故事里。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Walter Isaacson joins Google to discuss how history’s greatest innovators inspire creativity and human judgment in the AI age. Watch the episode.

stories.title: Gemini 更新后可替你整理文件、填写表单、跑多步骤流程
stories.sourceTitle: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
stories.summary: Google 对 Gemini 的最新更新把 AI agent 带到 Mac，可组织文件、填写表单并处理多步骤工作流。
stories.analysis: 与 The Verge 的报道同源，重点在于它能否真正替用户操作，而不只是回答问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google's latest update to Gemini brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and tackle multistep workflows.

stories.title: ChatGPT 上线 Live Dictation，边说边转写
stories.sourceTitle: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
stories.summary: 新功能不再等录音结束才转写，而是实时把语音转成文字；现已在网页、桌面端和 iOS 的 ChatGPT 所有套餐全球推送。
stories.analysis: 实时听写让语音更接近默认输入方式，对移动端的长 prompt 场景尤其有用。
stories.sourceExcerpt: ChatGPT can receive audio prompts from your microphone faster now with a Live Dictation feature that transcribes as you speak, rather than waiting until you finish recording. It's rolling out now globally on all ChatGPT plans on the web, desktop app, and iOS a

stories.title: 报道称 Meta 的 Muse 混淆对话，可能暴露他人隐私数据
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says
stories.summary: 员工称 Muse 曾显示他们从未提出的育儿请求、没有咨询过的职业建议、没有下过的订单，甚至还有不属于他们的银行账户余额。
stories.analysis: agent 的记忆和多用户隔离一旦出错，后果就是直接的数据泄露事故。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In some of these instances, employees said Muse surfaced messages about childcare requests they never made, career advice they never asked for, product orders they never placed, and bank account balances that didn't belong to them.

stories.title: 前阿里高管创立的 Everful 融资 4850 万美元，连接零售商与中国工厂
stories.sourceTitle: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
stories.summary: Everful 将用这笔资金扩展工厂直采平台，帮助零售商从海外制造商采购商品。
stories.analysis: AI 采购撮合的壁垒不在模型，而在工厂侧供给和履约数据。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Everful has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform, helping retailers source products from overseas manufacturers.

stories.title: Anthropic 纳斯达克开盘 111 美元，较发行价高 33%
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
stories.summary: Anthropic 的 IPO 定价为 83 美元，对应超过 800 亿美元的新募资金额，开盘价较发行价上涨约 33%。
stories.analysis: 首日溢价说明公开市场仍愿意为前沿模型公司给出稀缺性溢价。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic's IPO price was set at $83, representing more than $80 billion in new capital raised.

stories.title: 完成史上最大 IPO 后，Anthropic 的“好人”声誉面临考验
stories.sourceTitle: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic’s ‘good guy’ reputation is on the line
stories.summary: 此次 IPO 募资 813 亿美元，规模超过 SpaceX，成为史上最大 IPO，也为后续上市的其他 AI 实验室定下先例。
stories.analysis: 一旦要对公开市场负责，“安全优先”的叙事就必须接受季度业绩的检验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Today is a new beginning for Anthropic: a years-in-the-making IPO that beat out SpaceX for most valuable of all time, having raised $81.3 billion and set an important precedent for the other public AI lab debuts to come. But it's not simply a financial milesto

stories.title: Dario Amodei 敲钟讲话：不会因商业或政治压力加快 AI 开发
stories.sourceTitle: At Nasdaq opening bell, Anthropic CEO recommits to pacing AI development
stories.summary: Amodei 在纳斯达克开盘钟声的讲话中重申，Anthropic 会坚持控制 AI 发展节奏，无论商业或政治压力如何。
stories.analysis: 上市首日就把“放慢”写成公开承诺，是给监管者和员工的一颗定心丸。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In his Nasdaq opening bell speech, Dario Amodei reiterated Anthropic's commitment to pacing AI development, regardless of business or political pressure.

stories.title: 实测两周：让 Apple 常驻聆听的 AI 替我总结生活
stories.sourceTitle: I let Apple’s always-listening AI summarize my life for two weeks
stories.summary: 作者同时测试 Amazon Bee Frontier 和 Apple Watch Ultra 4 上的 Siri Recap，两者都能环境收音并用 AI 生成对话摘要。
stories.analysis: 常驻聆听的体验门槛已经跨过，真正的阻力是隐私信任而非技术本身。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Was it worth it? I've been asking myself this quite a bit over the last month or so while testing both the Amazon Bee Frontier and Siri Recap on the Apple Watch Ultra 4. Both enable a wearable to ambiently listen to your conversations and, using AI, summarize

stories.title: Anthropic 上市，AI 循环融资热潮迎来压力测试
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test
stories.summary: Anthropic 上市时背着巨额算力承诺，而 Amazon、Google 等最大基础设施伙伴即使 Anthropic 失去领先地位也能继续获利。
stories.analysis: 循环融资把风险从模型公司转移到云厂商，上市让这套结构第一次被公开定价。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, but its biggest infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Google, could continue profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead.

stories.title: Superhuman 把 Go 助手铺进 Docs 和 Mail
stories.sourceTitle: Superhuman pushes its Go assistant everywhere
stories.summary: Superhuman 将 Go 定为核心 agent，并在 Docs 与 Mail 中提供。
stories.analysis: 邮件和文档是 agent 最容易证明投资回报的入口，Superhuman 选择全线覆盖而非单点试验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Superhuman is making Go its central agent and making it available in Docs and Mail.

stories.title: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon，面向机器人控制、仿真和策略优化
stories.sourceTitle: 谷歌发布用于机器人控制、仿真和策略优化的 Gemini 4 Argon
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文报道，谷歌推出 Gemini 4 Argon，定位机器人控制、仿真和策略优化场景。
stories.analysis: 把 Gemini 从对话推向机器人策略层，是 Google 争夺具身智能基础模型的一步。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: 华为云 CloudRobo 组队发力，让具身机器人共享算力与适配
stories.sourceTitle: 具身机器人进入真机时代，华为云CloudRobo开始组队发力了
stories.summary: 量子位报道，一批卡可以轮流服务多家公司，一次适配能让更多团队受益，算力不必家家从头买，工程上的坑也不用家家重踩。
stories.analysis: 共享算力加统一适配层是降低具身智能门槛的现实路径，也让华为云更像机器人公司的公共底座。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 一批卡可以轮流服务多家公司，一次适配也能让更多团队受益。算力不必家家从头买，工程上的坑也不用家家重新踩。

stories.title: Qwen 推出 Qwen3Guard，对 token 流做实时安全防护
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: 这是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 基座并针对安全分类微调，可对生成中的 token 流实时判别。
stories.analysis: 把审核从事后过滤变成逐 token 实时拦截，对 agent 和高并发 API 场景更实用。
